notes.title: My Grandpa's Haunted House is now available on Steam!

[h1]Get Indie Horror Games Bundle #2 here:[/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33469/Indie_Horror_Games_Bundle_2/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #1 - Bugs Fixed and Solved Performance Issues - V1.0.0.19
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is the first major update for Keatz: The Lonely Bird after its release in January. I have received some valuable feedback from the Steam community and I made the changes based on them. I have solved some of the major issues and minor bugs like mission objectives not visible and so on. Here is an overview of the changes made in V1.0.0.19.

[b]Features Improved/Added:[/b]

1. Some bugs are fixed.

2. Added more lives in some levels so that the player can get lives often and it is also necessary because you will end up having only one life when you load the game as you have already lost the lives in previous session of gameplay. It will happen because you are loading one of the saved levels with the previous changes. Having more lives is more likely to solve the problem.

3. Mission Objectives are currently visible on Loading screen. It was already present in the previous version but I have added an additional option called "Press 'Space' or 'Start' button to continue" which will appear after the level loads completely so that you can read the full information on that page. In previous version, the level used to automatically load after the loading process is done which used to prevent the user from reading the Mission objectives and any other necessary information. This is now fixed.

4. Another complaint which I have received from the community is the Performance issues (frame-rate drop) in Low-end PCs. To remedy this issue, I have optimized the game for low-end machines. I have already tested the new build in one of my old PCs and it runs at a stable frame-rate. I hope that you will not experience any lag during gameplay and it should run at 30fps. 

I hope that you will enjoy the game and if you have any further suggestions or queries please feel free to write in the comments below. I will try to get back to you as soon as possible. 

Thank you very much for supporting my game and I have received lots of valuable feedback which has helped me to improve the game. I will keep providing updates and fix as many bugs as possible.

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Keatz: The Lonely Bird is Live on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The waiting time is over! I have successfully released Keatz: The Lonely Bird on Steam. I had been working on this game for about a year and I am proud to be able to release it on Steam. You can now enjoy the full game and it currently has partial controller support. 

Some features of this game are:

1. Many Boss levels.
2. Different items to collect.
3. Steam Achievements are added already!
4. In-Game achievements.

Here are some gifs showing the gameplay here:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J3vsbA5Z3LQUnw4/giphy.gif[/img]
The image given above shows one of the boss levels.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J9Dy6slxrjgHn4A/giphy.gif[/img]
The image given above shows a level which is full of deadly traps.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohhwIIBziRl2sUdq0/giphy.gif[/img]
The image given above shows the fighter plane. 

I hope you will enjoy the game and I will keep providing updates from time to time. If you have queries, please feel free to ask me queries.

notes.title: Keatz - The Lonely Bird Store Page is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

How are you doing guys? I am Anamik, an indie game developer and I have created this little action platformer for all of you.

This is my second major game project which will be available on Steam soon. I had released my first game called NightmareZ which had received some attention and feedback. Those feedback which I received from Steam community had drastically improved my game and I created this game keeping those ideas in mind. I have been developing this game for about 11 months and it is still under development. I am currently fixing bugs and improving some parts of the game to make it better. I hope that you will have a great time playing it after it gets released on Steam.

Being a solo developer, I have created graphics, background art, cover art, all sorts of character designs, animation, programming, story, level design, except the music. However, it was a great experience for me working on this title and I have learned a lot during its development process. 

[b]Some important features available from the time of release:[/b]

- [b]Auto Save at the beginning of each and every level so that you never lose any data and are saved automatically in different slots.[/b]

- [b]Load your saved data directly from menu(Multiple slots).[/b]

- [b]XBOX 360 Controller Support (Other generic controllers will also work).[/b]

- [b]Two modes of difficulty including Easy and Hard.[/b]

- [b]Pause menu with the options to exit or resume the game.[/b]

My primary goal is to make my customers happy and your feedback is valuable for me because it will definitely help making my product better. If you have queries regarding this game, please feel free to ask me and I will try to answer to all of you.

Meanwhile, if you are interested you can add this game to your wishlist so that you get notified as soon as it is released on Steam. Thank you very much for your continuous support! 

Have a nice day!

Best Regards,
Anamik
